  asm POP{%{c__5}}{%{qw_option}} %{registers__5}

  cond !(([28:25] IN {'00xx'})) && !(((([24:24] == '0') && ([23:23] == '0')) && ([21:21] == '0')))

  in <Rn> Rn

enc LDM_T2 T32 32

  in ! W
  in <Rn> Rn

  in ! W
